name: Solar Auto-Darkening Welding Helmet with Flip Front Protective Lens
shortDescription: Solar-assisted variable shade (DIN 9-13) auto-darkening welding hood with dual arc sensors, external grind mode, and 4-point ergonomic ratchet headgear.
overview: Providing comprehensive optical protection for professional welders, this solar-powered auto-darkening welding helmet seamlessly switches from clear shade DIN 4 to dark shade DIN 9-13 within 1/25,000th of a second upon arc ignition. Constructed from ultra-tough, high-impact polyamide nylon, the lightweight shell shields the face, neck, and ears from direct radiation, radiant heat, and molten spatter. It features high optical clarity ratings (1/1/1/2) for accurate weld pool inspection, an external dial for stepless shade adjustment, and an independent grind function allowing continuous eye protection during post-weld grinding.
keyFeatures: Ultra-fast switching speed under 1/25,000 second from light to dark
Variable shade selection from DIN 9 to DIN 13 with external sensitivity dial
Dual high-sensitivity arc sensors for instantaneous arc detection in MMA, MIG, and TIG
Clear shade DIN 4 in non-welding state for effortless setup and alignment
External grinding switch locks lens in shade 4 for grinding safety
Solar cells backed by replaceable long-life CR2032 lithium battery
Ergonomic 4-point multi-adjustable ratchet headgear with plush moisture-wicking sweatband
High impact resistant nylon shell meeting EN 175 B and ANSI Z87.1
applications: Plasma arc cutting, gouging, and angle grinding
packageContents: 1x Auto-Darkening Welding Helmet with Ratchet Headband
2x Spare Outer Clear Polycarbonate Protective Lenses
